import secrets

class User:
    """
    Represents a user with an email address.
    
    Attributes:
        email (str): The email address of the user.
    """

    def __init__(self, email):
        """
        Initializes a new instance of the User class.
        
        Args:
            email (str): The email address of the user.
        """
        self.email = email

    @classmethod
    def admin(cls):
        """
        Creates and returns a new instance of the User class with hardcoded values.
        
        Returns:
            User: A new instance of the User class.
        """
        return cls(email="admin@example.com")

    @classmethod
    def random_data(cls):
        """
        Generates random values for the username and password and returns a new instance of the User class.
        
        Returns:
            User: A new instance of the User class.
        """
        username = secrets.token_urlsafe(16)
        password = secrets.token_urlsafe(16)
        return cls(email=f"{username}@{password}.com")
